options: One who rejects idols and claims to follow the religion of Ibrahim
questions.explain: Before prophethood there were four who rejected idols but did not know the way.

questions.q: What were the azlam that Quraysh used?
questions.explain: Azlam, bird omens and idol worship were superstitions.

questions.q: What did Zaid bin Amr do for baby girls about to be buried alive?
options: Took care of and raised her
questions.explain: A caring conscience even without material benefit.

questions.q: What happened to Zaid bin Amr on his way home?
questions.explain: Zaid was told the final prophet would emerge from Makkah, but did not live to meet him.

questions.q: What does ummatan wahdah mean for Zaid?
options: He stood alone but as one whole nation
questions.explain: Though without revelation, Zaid will be raised alone as one nation.

questions.q: Which son of Zaid bin Amr was learning the Quran with his wife when Umar arrived?
questions.explain: Said and his wife Fatimah bint Khattab were learning the Quran.

options: Reflecting deeply on the verses of the Quran
questions.explain: The ustaz stresses it as a shot to make us think more deeply.

questions.q: Even educated people can fall into irrational beliefs.
questions.explain: True. Think with reason, not superstition.

questions.q: Zaid bin Amr stood alone against the practice of the whole city.
questions.explain: True. Dare to differ, guided by principle.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Zaid is killed on his journey home
Zaid bin Amr meets the young Prophet SAW

questions.explain: Four rejected idols, Zaid met the young Prophet, saved a baby girl, and was killed on the way home.

questions.q: We already have the Quran, hadith and many classes. What is the real question?
options: What we do with the knowledge we have
questions.explain: The heart can be locked even while attending lectures.
